title: Picasso Walking Tour
text: Our guide, Juan, was absolutely fantastic — incredibly knowledgeable, engaging, and passionate about Picasso’s life and legacy. He brought Picasso’s story to life with fascinating insights into the artist’s deep connection to Barcelona and his lasting cultural impact. What made this tour even more special was Juan’s introduction to the charming neighborhood of El Born — a beautiful area we wouldn’t have discovered on our own. This was far more than just an art tour — it was an unforgettable journey through history, creativity, and the heart of the city. Highly recommend!
author: Christine_H

title: I thoroughly enjoyed the...
text: I thoroughly enjoyed the Picasso walking tour. I'm so glad we chose this tour over the Picasso museum tour. Juan did an excellent job of storytelling, blending Picasso's life with Catalan history. I highly recommend this experience.
